sources.title: Night falls for everyone | An in-depth Vayne Guide!

passive.name: Night Hunter
passive.text: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

spells.name: Tumble
spells.text: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.

spells.name: Silver Bolts
spells.text: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.

spells.name: Condemn
spells.text: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.

spells.name: Final Hour
spells.text: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter

damage.value: Vayne deals sustained damage through Silver Bolts’ percent-max-health true damage, which ignores resistances.

archetype.value: Vayne is an ADC hyper-carry who excels at dueling and kiting.

axis.value: Vayne should last-hit and avoid poke at level 1, then avoid forcing extended trades.

winCondition.value: Vayne wins by positioning at maximum range, focusing the nearest threat, and kiting backwards.

spikes.why: Vayne gains outplay potential with Tumble and Condemn.

spikes.at: Experimental Hexplate, Essence Reaver, and Stormrazor
spikes.why: Vayne reaches a standard mid-game power spike with these items.

bait.why: Vayne loses a self-peel tool against divers and assassins when Condemn is spent.

mistakes.value: Vayne makes a mistake by fishing for Condemn stuns instead of saving it for self-peel.
Vayne gives up outplay opportunities when she neglects positioning or Silver Bolts timing.
Vayne misses Silver Bolts' true damage if she does not land three consecutive attacks or abilities on the same target.
